messages:
Maria (AE): Customer SIG asks for BCP/DR details: RTO/RPO, backup cadence/retention, restore test evidence, failover mechanics, and SLA text. Need concise answers + a short runbook excerpt to attach.

Jordan (Security): I'll draft. Split by Hosted vs Dedicated/Private. Keep hosted conservative and reference SLA/SOW.

Sam (Eng): Facts: control plane replicated across AZs; primary DB WAL-shipped to standby in secondary region; object storage snapshots hourly and nightly fulls; default retention 30d; caches ephemeral and rebuilt.

Jordan (Security): Draft SIG lines: Hosted — Multi-AZ replication, automated hourly snapshots and WAL shipping. RTO objective (control plane): <=1 hour for control-plane recovery; RPO for persisted customer data: ~15 minutes. Dedicated/Private — RTO/RPO configurable per SOW and can be tightened.

Jordan (Security): Failover mechanics: health checks + smart routing shift traffic to healthy cluster; for region loss we trigger cross-region DNS failover and promote standby. Routing switchover typically 1–5 min; full data restore depends on dataset size.

Sam (Eng): Backups/retention: hourly incremental, nightly fulls retained 30 days by default. Longer retention/export available as add-on. Testing: quarterly restore drills; can provide sanitized screenshots/logs as evidence.

Olivia (Legal): Suggested SLA wording: "Hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; Dedicated: 99.95% (per contract). Remedies per SLA terms; exclusions apply (customer misconfig, third-party network, force majeure)." Avoid definitive promises outside contract.

Sam (Eng): Runbook excerpt to attach:

```
Failover test excerpt
1) Notify: announce in #eng-oncall and set maintenance flag
2) Trigger: switch routing to secondary region/cluster
3) Smoke: curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api-secondary.redwood.ai/health
4) Validate: replication lag <30s, sample requests succeed
5) Restore: re-sync primary from backups, monitor until steady state
Evidence: include screenshots, controller logs, and runbook entry timestamps
```

DR Playbook Bot: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/dr-tests/latest — last full restore drill 2025-03-11 (index #38).

Maria (AE): Good — I'll paste into SIG spreadsheet and request scrubbed drill artifacts.

Jordan (Security): I'll pull and scrub logs; upload within 24h.

Olivia (Legal): LGTM. Keep hosted answers conservative and refer to SLA/SOW. :white_check_mark:

Maria (AE): Thanks team — sending to customer and will update thread with any follow-ups.
